maximumProviderSpendUsd.note: Hard ceiling, not a target. The runner refuses any attempt whose worst-case projected cumulative cost would exceed it.

capturePreparation.defaultPolicyRationale: Production parity outweighs the earlier 'maximum dimension' wording. Portrait images preserve the same width-based behaviour as the production client, so their long edge exceeds 896 exactly as in production.
capturePreparation.immutableRunIdentityNote: Derivative hashes are covered transitively: the preparation-manifest hash is computed over every per-image derivative hash, the policy, the codec and the certified contract. capturePreparation.payloadRangeStatement: All prepared payloads remain below the certified ceiling and overlap the documented production payload range. Complete band parity is NOT claimed: the prepared range is 25-299 KB with a 94 KB mean against a documented production typical of 120-320 KB.
